jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 19a (logging-only visibility round). Read docs/state/silent-failures.md methodology (top) and its '### tools/githook-check.mjs' section. Edit ONLY tools/githook-check.mjs. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, throws, defaults, or hook exit codes.

This file runs inside git hooks, so stderr is shown to users on every commit/push. The normal paths MUST stay silent; log only truly unexpected errors.

No logger exists in this file. Use: console.error('[tools/githook-check.mjs] <short context>:', error?.message ?? error)

execFileSync note: when git runs and exits nonzero (key unset, unknown ref), the thrown error has a numeric `error.status`. Treat that as expected and stay silent. Anything without a numeric status (ENOENT = git missing, ETIMEDOUT / signal kill from the timeout) is unexpected: log it.

Flagged lines (file unchanged since the audit, line numbers are current):
1. Line 113, gitCommentChar: `} catch { /* default */ }` around `git config --get core.commentChar`. Exit status 1 is the normal 'not set' case on almost every commit. Bind the error; stay silent when typeof error?.status === 'number'; log otherwise. Still fall through to return '#'.
2. Line 162, shouldSkipCommitMsgCheck: `} catch { /* ignore */ }` around gitDir()+fs.existsSync checks. Neither normally throws, so anything caught here is unexpected: bind and log unconditionally, then fall through as today.
3. Line 169, shouldSkipCommitMsgCheck: `} catch { /* ignore */ }` around readCommitSubjectFromFile(msgPath, ...). A missing message file (error?.code === 'ENOENT') is expected: stay silent. Log anything else (include msgPath). Fall through as today.
4. Line 267, syntheticRefsWhenStdinEmpty: `try { remoteSha = gitQuiet(...) } catch { /* first push */ }`. rev-parse fails with a numeric status on a first push: stay silent for typeof error?.status === 'number', log otherwise. remoteSha keeps its zero default.

Do NOT touch any other catch (guardOff line 23, gitDir line 126, the nested ahead catches at line 268-269, etc.). Do not refactor, reformat, rename, or change exports. A small private helper for the numeric-status check is fine; do not export it.

FORBIDDEN shortcut patterns (rejected in review): `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` never logged, `void error`, any binding not used in a real check or console.error.

Then run the covering tests with: node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/commit-msg-round2.test.mjs tests/commit-msg-round3.test.mjs tests/review-high-regressions.test.mjs tests/hooks-repoint-all.test.mjs tests/git-hooks.test.mjs tests/githook-push-range.test.mjs tests/commit-msg-manifest.test.mjs tests/commit-msg-review.test.mjs and confirm green. Final summary: one line per flagged line.
